title: Proof of Making
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: Proof of Making: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: Proof of making is a chain of contemporaneous records that can support authorship, development, contribution, and custody questions without pretending that documentation itself decides ownership.
frames.alt: Title plate for Proof of Making.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: A documented copy after a Worth model makes the line between reference, attribution, and surviving object evidence visible.
frames.credit: Gift of Miss Agnes Miles Carpenter, 1941
frames.alt: A pale 1896 bridesmaid dress by A. F. Jammes, catalogued by The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
frames.treatment: local display and download with attached credit

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · ORIGIN — What is the earliest reliable record?. Preserve native file, physical notebook or sample, creator, date basis, device or system context, identifier, and custody. Distinguish recorded time from an unverified recollection.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what is the earliest reliable record? within Proof of Making.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · CHANGE — Can development be reconstructed?. Link versions, annotations, patterns, fittings, samples, approvals, and rejected alternatives. Keep contributor corrections and disagreements rather than overwriting them.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can development be reconstructed? within Proof of Making.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · RIGHT — What does the evidence not decide?. Separate factual creation history from U.S. copyright authorship, work-made-for-hire, transfer, contract, patent, design, trademark, foreign-law, and confidentiality questions.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what does the evidence not decide? within Proof of Making.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · CUSTODY — Can the chain survive movement?. Record every deposit, handoff, copy, migration, sale, loan, publication, return, and deletion with responsible person and integrity check.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the chain survive movement? within Proof of Making.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields
